entities.name: RibBA
observations: 398-aa query has 57.6–59.4% identity and ~99.5% query coverage to reviewed RibBA homologs; evidence supports moderate-homology functional assignment.
Query contains DHBP_synthase (PF00926; residues 8–197) and GTP_cyclohydro2 (PF00925; residues 210–372) domains.
Homolog annotations assign EC 4.1.99.12 and EC 3.5.4.25 activities in riboflavin biosynthesis.

entities.name: Ribulose-5-P to DHBP
observations: RHEA:18457: D-ribulose 5-phosphate → (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate + formate + H+; EC 4.1.99.12 activity.

entities.name: GTP cyclohydrolysis
observations: RHEA:23704: GTP + 4 H2O → 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + formate + 2 phosphate + 3 H+; EC 3.5.4.25 activity. Homolog annotations also describe the product as DARP with pyrophosphate, reflecting representation differences.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA homologs are annotated with two entry reactions that supply intermediates to riboflavin biosynthesis.
